description: This shambling corpse is dressed like a medical professional.  It was either a doctor, or only played one on TV.
A malformed armor of misshapen bone has grown over this zombie, having pushed what remains of the skin out of the way.  The clothes of a medical worker are still draped over it.
This is the body of a doctor or nurse of some kind.  It's hard to tell now that most of its clothing has corroded away from whatever vile acid its secreting.
